comments.author: mmorel-35
comments.body:
Why do you need this replacement ? 
Can’t a tool be used to `html encode` so it stays human readable ?

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: This is a special case where we _don't_ want actual spaces to be present. We are injecting the ` ` ourselves here, to avoid line breaks. (which was not happening previously, as the regex wouldn't match) I think it was not present in the test before, as the spaces were encoded as [`U+00A0`](https://www.compart.com/en/unicode/U+00A0), which is unicode version of ` `. This is evident from the VSCode screenshot below. As this is in the internals and not visible to users, ` ` feels like a better option than unicode.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: ` ` was already being used in other places in the same file.
